svg.title: Selected current model cells compared with historical Claude Opus 4

cc:Work.dc:title: Selected current model cells compared with historical Claude Opus 4
cc:Work.dc:description: A horizontal point-and-interval plot shows Qwen3.5-27B at 89.6 percent, DeepSeek V4 Flash at 78.5 percent, Mistral Medium 3.5 at 32.5 percent, GPT-5.5 at 10.5 percent, and Claude Opus 5 at zero. Historical Claude Opus 4 is shown separately at 87.8 percent.
